$Comment: Bring down the Headless Horseman during one season with nothing but Lantern Bombs hitting his body.
ENCOUNTER_FEAT names his fight's encounter script and the feat Lanterns_Only, which his binding row
lands on his body must come from a Lantern Bomb's blast, shards or burn, while his Head and the Jack
Skeletons may be hit with anything. One sword swing on his body from anyone breaks it for that fight.
Every player the win credits earns it at once.
Each year's copy pays MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row in Claim, Artillery XP, to collect on the
achievements page; the row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server
without that mod. It carries no hallowed tag, so The Hallowed never waits on it.
